# TETO FULL-EXPANSION 177 — Staged Catalog generator (WS-R + WS-I bulk registration). stdlib only.
#
# Reads (read-only):
#   docs/design/data/TETO_RECIPE_172_GAME-DESIGN-CANDIDATE_MATRIX.json   (172 design rows; ingredient token traces)
#   <rows.json>  = PR #781 docs/reports/data/TETO_POOL-REJUDGE_87_rows.json (87 unshipped rows; re-generated byte-identical on main)
#   src/data/ingredients.ts / src/data/lateCatalog.ts / src/data/recipes.ts (shipped ids only, by regex)
# Writes:
#   src/data/staged/testSupport/stagedRecipes.ts      (WS-R: 73 recipes)
#   src/data/staged/testSupport/stagedIngredients.ts  (WS-I: staged ingredient candidates)
#
# Run: python3 -I docs/reports/data/TETO_FULL-EXPANSION-177_stage-gen.py.txt <repo> <rows.json>
# Deterministic: same inputs -> byte-identical outputs. `.txt` so CI's extension classifier treats it as docs.
#
# Owner provisional rules applied here (2026-11-07; recommendations of the plan §9 adopted as PROVISIONAL rules;
# any irreversible exclusion and every final id are re-judged later). Each application is recorded on the entry.
#   I-1  alias candidate -> reuse the shipped id ONLY if the substituted identity set hits NO duplicate gate at all
#        (identical / subset / superset / Jaccard > 0.4) against shipped + other staged; otherwise keep the new id.
#   I-2  merges: puntarelle -> chicory ; nutella-spread -> chocolate (brand-free generic id). cabbage / red-cabbage,
#        radicchio, lime stay separate.
#   I-3  prepared composites are ONE ingredient (french-fries does not depend on FRY).
#   R-1..R-8 are NOT resolved by data here: they become open dependencies (kind OWNER_RULE) on the entry, so the
#        unresolved count stays honest. R-6 (raw/salad toppings -> existing post_bake) IS applied where the matrix
#        names the post-bake ingredients, because it only selects an already shipped mechanism.
import json, re, sys, os, collections

repo, rows_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
P = lambda *a: os.path.join(repo, *a)
matrix = json.load(open(P("docs/design/data/TETO_RECIPE_172_GAME-DESIGN-CANDIDATE_MATRIX.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
mrows = {r["evidenceId"]: r for r in matrix["rows"]}
rj = json.load(open(rows_path, encoding="utf-8"))
SPREAD = set(matrix["spreadLayerIngredientIds"])

def ids_in(path, pat=r'^\s+id: "([a-z0-9-]+)"'):
    return set(re.findall(pat, open(P(path), encoding="utf-8").read(), re.M))
src_ing = open(P("src/data/ingredients.ts"), encoding="utf-8").read()
base_ing = src_ing[src_ing.index("BASE_INGREDIENTS"):]
SHIPPED_ING = set(re.findall(r'^\s+id: "([a-z0-9-]+)",\n\s+category:', base_ing, re.M))
late = open(P("src/data/lateCatalog.ts"), encoding="utf-8").read()
SHIPPED_ING |= set(re.findall(r'^\s+id: "([a-z0-9-]+)",\n\s+category:', late, re.M))
SHIPPED_CAT = {}
for m_ in re.finditer(r'id: "([a-z0-9-]+)",\n\s+category: "(sauce|cheese|topping)"', src_ing + late):
    SHIPPED_CAT[m_.group(1)] = m_.group(2)
SHIPPED_RECIPE_IDS = set(rj["summary"]["auditedRecipeIds"])

IN_FLIGHT = {"pesto-burrata-pizzadb-p12": "#783", "pizza-alla-crudaiola-pizzadb-p8": "#783", "pesto-noci-pizzadb-p12": "B20-A", "taco-pizza-pizzadb": "B21 (shipped, #780)", "okonomiyaki-style-pizza-pizzadb-p1": "B21 (shipped, #780)", "speck-e-brie-pizzadb-p4": "B22 (shipped, #780)", "buffalo-chicken-pizzadb": "B22 (shipped, #780)", "pizza-finocchi-salad-pizzadb-p8": "B22 (shipped, #780)", "pizza-cavolo-carote-pizzadb-p8": "B22 (shipped, #780)", "pizza-radicchio-noci-pizzadb-p8": "B22 (shipped, #780)", "black-truffle-pizza-pizzadb-p14": "B22 (shipped, #780)", "apple-cinnamon-dessert-pizzadb": "B23 (shipped, #780)", "nutella-dessert-pizza-pizzadb-p6": "B23 (shipped, #780)", "smore-dessert-pizza-pizzadb-p4": "B23 (shipped, #780)"}
RESERVED_RECIPE_IDS = {"pesto-burrata-pizza", "pizza-alla-crudaiola", "pesto-noci-pizza", "taco-pizza", "okonomiyaki-style-pizza", "speck-e-brie", "buffalo-chicken", "pizza-finocchi-salad", "pizza-cavolo-carote", "pizza-radicchio-noci", "black-truffle-pizza", "apple-cinnamon-dessert", "nutella-dessert-pizza", "smore-dessert-pizza"}
RESERVED_ING_IDS = {"burrata": "#783", "honey": "B20-A", "walnut": "B20-A", "cheddar": "B21", "lettuce": "B21", "tortilla-chips": "B21", "okonomiyaki-sauce": "B21", "cabbage": "B21", "bonito-flakes": "B21", "fennel": "B22", "orange": "B22", "carrot": "B22", "red-cabbage": "B22", "sunflower-seeds": "B22", "radicchio": "B22", "truffle": "B22", "brie": "B22", "buffalo-sauce": "B22", "balsamic-vinegar": "B22", "apple": "B23", "banana": "B23", "chocolate": "B23", "powdered-sugar": "B23", "graham-cracker": "B23", "marshmallow": "B23"}

# kind / family / provisional category for every candidate (manual, mirrors plan appendix B)
KIND = {
 "honey":"LIQUID","walnut":"NUT","lettuce":"VEG","burrata":"CHEESE","blue-cheese-dressing":"SAUCE","carrot":"VEG","cucumber":"VEG",
 "french-fries":"COMPOSITE","apple":"FRUIT","cheddar":"CHEESE","ground-beef":"MEAT","salsa":"SAUCE","tortilla-chips":"COMPOSITE",
 "buffalo-sauce":"SAUCE","kebab-sauce":"SAUCE","caciocavallo":"CHEESE","brie":"CHEESE","chocolate":"DESSERT","graham-cracker":"DESSERT",
 "marshmallow":"DESSERT","peanut-sauce":"SAUCE","eel":"SEAFOOD","sansho-pepper":"SPICE","cumin":"SPICE","bonito-flakes":"SEAFOOD",
 "cabbage":"VEG","okonomiyaki-sauce":"SAUCE","kimchi":"VEG","chicken-tikka":"COMPOSITE","spicy-salami":"MEAT","brick-cheese":"CHEESE",
 "banana":"FRUIT","nutella-spread":"SAUCE","powdered-sugar":"DESSERT","daikon":"VEG","liver-pate":"COMPOSITE","cauliflower":"VEG",
 "yogurt-sauce":"SAUCE","asparagus":"VEG","celery":"VEG","fennel":"VEG","orange":"FRUIT","red-cabbage":"VEG","sunflower-seeds":"NUT",
 "chicory":"VEG","pecorino":"CHEESE","puntarelle":"VEG","balsamic-vinegar":"LIQUID","radicchio":"VEG","cheese-curd":"CHEESE",
 "gravy-sauce":"SAUCE","condensed-milk":"LIQUID","melted-butter":"LIQUID","rock-salt":"SPICE","blueberry":"FRUIT","kiwi":"FRUIT",
 "strawberry":"FRUIT","squid":"SEAFOOD","aji-amarillo":"SAUCE","natto":"COMPOSITE","okra":"VEG","peking-duck":"COMPOSITE",
 "sweet-bean-sauce":"SAUCE","mentaiko":"SEAFOOD","mochi":"COMPOSITE","halloumi":"CHEESE","zaatar":"SPICE","yakiniku-sauce":"SAUCE",
 "chili-powder":"SPICE","cotija":"CHEESE","lime":"FRUIT","truffle":"COMPOSITE","chutney":"SAUCE",
}
FAMILY_OVERRIDE = {"french-fries":"vegetable","chicken-tikka":"meat","liver-pate":"meat","peking-duck":"meat","truffle":"vegetable",
                   "kimchi":"vegetable","zaatar":"herb","natto":"other","mochi":"other","tortilla-chips":"other"}
FAMILY_BY_KIND = {"VEG":"vegetable","FRUIT":"fruit","MEAT":"meat","SEAFOOD":"seafood","SPICE":"spice","NUT":"spice","DESSERT":"other","COMPOSITE":"other"}
ALIAS = {"ground-beef":"beef","spicy-salami":"salami","mentaiko":"cod-roe","chili-powder":"paprika-powder","cotija":"feta",
         "brick-cheese":"mozzarella","pecorino":"grana-padano","salsa":"tomato-sauce","blue-cheese-dressing":"gorgonzola","chicken-tikka":"chicken"}
MERGE = {"puntarelle":"chicory","nutella-spread":"chocolate"}
COMPOSITE = {"french-fries","tortilla-chips","graham-cracker","liver-pate","peking-duck"}

def category_of(i):
    if i in SHIPPED_CAT: return SHIPPED_CAT[i]
    k = KIND[i]
    if i in SPREAD or k in ("SAUCE",): return "sauce"
    if k == "CHEESE": return "cheese"
    return "topping"

# ---- duplicate gate (same rule as #781 / #772 jaccard.py: id sets, counts ignored, sauce counts as ingredient) ----
def gate(a, b):
    a, b = set(a), set(b)
    if a == b: return "IDENTICAL"
    if a < b: return "SUBSET"
    if a > b: return "SUPERSET"
    j = len(a & b) / len(a | b)
    if j > 0.4: return "JACCARD"
    return None

shipped_sets = {}  # shipped recipe identity sets from #781 rows are not stored; rebuild from recipes.ts requiredIngredients
rsrc = open(P("src/data/recipes.ts"), encoding="utf-8").read() + late
for m_ in re.finditer(r'\{\s*id: "([a-z0-9-]+)",\s*nameJa:.*?requiredIngredients: \[(.*?)\]', rsrc, re.S):
    rid = m_.group(1)
    if rid in SHIPPED_RECIPE_IDS:
        shipped_sets[rid] = sorted(set(re.findall(r'ingredientId: "([a-z0-9-]+)"', m_.group(2))))
assert set(shipped_sets) == SHIPPED_RECIPE_IDS, sorted(SHIPPED_RECIPE_IDS ^ set(shipped_sets))

work = [r for r in rj["rows"] if r["evidenceId"] not in IN_FLIGHT]
assert len(work) == 73, len(work)

def name_of(ing_id):
    for r in matrix["rows"]:
        for t in r["ingredients"]["tokenTrace"]:
            if t.get("canonicalId") == ing_id: return t["token"]
    return ing_id

# I-2 merges first (pure renames), then I-1 per recipe with the duplicate check.
recs = []
for r in work:
    m = mrows[r["evidenceId"]]
    ident = [MERGE.get(i, i) for i in r["identitySet"]]
    applied = [f"I-2:{k}->{v}" for k, v in MERGE.items() if k in r["identitySet"]]
    # The matrix's base sauce is part of the recipe. For identity-incomplete rows the matrix has no identityIngredientSet and #781 falls back
    # to canonicalIngredientIds, which omits a family-derived sauce (e.g. quad-cities = mozzarella only). Add it back (Codex P2, PR #787).
    base = MERGE.get(m["sauceBase"].get("baseIngredientId"), m["sauceBase"].get("baseIngredientId"))
    if base and base not in ident:
        ident.append(base); applied.append(f"SAUCE:base {base} added from matrix sauceBase ({m['sauceBase']['status']})")
    recs.append({"r": r, "m": m, "ident": sorted(set(ident)), "applied": applied, "base": base})

def hits(rid, ident, others):
    out = []
    for sid, s in shipped_sets.items():
        g = gate(ident, s)
        if g: out.append(g)
    for o in others:
        if o["id"] != rid:
            g = gate(ident, o["ident"])
            if g: out.append(g)
    return out

for x in recs:
    x["id"] = x["m"]["canonicalCandidateId"]
for x in recs:
    for cand, target in ALIAS.items():
        if cand not in x["ident"]: continue
        trial = sorted(set(target if i == cand else i for i in x["ident"]))
        after = hits(x["id"], trial, recs)
        if not after:  # I-1: reuse ONLY when the substituted set hits no duplicate gate at all (Codex P2, PR #787)
            x["ident"] = trial; x["applied"].append(f"I-1:{cand}->{target}(reuse)")
            if x["base"] == cand: x["base"] = target  # keep the sauce metadata consistent with the requirements (Codex P2, PR #787)
        else:
            x["applied"].append(f"I-1:{cand}(kept: reuse hits the duplicate gate)")

MECH_KEY = {"DOUGH_VARIANT":"DOUGH_VARIANT","PAN_BAKE:other":"PAN_PROFILE","DOUGH_SHAPE_TARGET":"DOUGH_SHAPE_TARGET","ENCLOSE":"ENCLOSE",
            "LATE_ADDITION:mid_bake":"MID_BAKE","PREP_STEP":"PREP","FRY_COOK":"FRY","STEP_ORDER":"STEP_ORDER","ZONED_PLACEMENT":"ZONED",
            "LAMINATE":"LAMINATE","MULTI_SPREAD_LAYER":"MULTI_SPREAD_3"}
OWNER_RULE_OF = {"BASE_SAUCE_UNSPECIFIED":"R-1","SUBSET_OF_SHIPPED_FORBIDDEN":"R-2","SUPERSET_OF_SHIPPED_FORBIDDEN":"R-2",
                 "IDENTICAL_SET_AXIS_SEPARATED":"R-3","JACCARD_OVER_0.4_EXCEPTION":"R-4","COMPOSITION_CONFLICT_CANDIDATE":"R-5",
                 "MECHANIC_INTERPRETATION":"R-6","UNRESOLVED_INGREDIENT":"R-7","EVIDENCE_GAP":"R-8","SCOPE_QUESTION":"R-8",
                 "DISCOVERY_COLLISION":"R-8","PREPARED_COMPOSITE_INGREDIENT":"R-8","SOURCE_INCONSISTENCY":"R-8"}

used_ing = collections.defaultdict(list)
out_recipes = []
for x in recs:
    r, m = x["r"], x["m"]
    rid = x["id"]
    assert rid not in SHIPPED_RECIPE_IDS and rid not in RESERVED_RECIPE_IDS, rid
    post = set()
    for f in m["postBakeFinish"]:
        if f["mode"] == "post_bake": post |= set(MERGE.get(i, i) for i in f["ingredients"])
    if post and r["primaryOwnerReason"] == "MECHANIC_INTERPRETATION": x["applied"].append("R-6:post_bake(shipped)")
    req = []
    for i in x["ident"]:
        cat = category_of(i)
        q = {"ingredientId": i, "minCount": 1 if cat == "sauce" else (3 if cat == "cheese" else 2)}
        if i in post: q["applicationPhase"] = "POST_BAKE"
        req.append(q)
        if i not in SHIPPED_ING and i not in RESERVED_ING_IDS: used_ing[i].append(rid)
    mech = sorted(set(MECH_KEY[k["key"]] for k in r["mechanicMissingOrGated"]))
    reasons = sorted(set(r["blockerTypes"]) | set(r["reviewItemTypes"]) | ({r["dupGate"]} if r["dupGate"] not in ("NONE", None) else set()))
    rules = sorted(set(OWNER_RULE_OF[t] for t in reasons if t in OWNER_RULE_OF))
    unresolved = [t["token"] for t in m["ingredients"]["unresolvedTokens"]]
    sauce = m["sauceBase"]
    out_recipes.append({
        "id": rid, "evidenceId": r["evidenceId"], "nameJa": m["nameJa"], "origin": m.get("origin") or "",
        "requiredIngredients": req,
        "sauce": {"status": sauce["status"], "baseIngredientId": x["base"]},
        "dough": {"class": m["dough"]["class"], "variant": m["dough"].get("variant"), "shape": m["dough"].get("shape")},
        "pan": m["cookingProfile"].get("pan"),
        "mechanics": mech,
        "ownerRules": rules, "ownerReasons": reasons,
        "unresolvedTokens": unresolved,
        # Raw matrix inputs for the re-judgement (stagedRejudge.ts); data only, nothing here is applied.
        "sauceFamilyRaw": sauce.get("sauceFamily") or "",
        "unresolvedRelatedIds": [[t["token"], list(t.get("relatedIds") or [])] for t in m["ingredients"]["unresolvedTokens"]],
        "lateModes": [{"mode": f["mode"], "ingredients": [MERGE.get(i, i) for i in f["ingredients"]]} for f in m["postBakeFinish"]],
        "identityComplete": bool(r["identitySetComplete"]),
        "applied": x["applied"],
        "inFlightIngredients": sorted(i for i in x["ident"] if i in RESERVED_ING_IDS),
        "lane": ("R-A" if not [i for i in x["ident"] if i not in SHIPPED_ING or i in RESERVED_ING_IDS] else "R-B") if not mech else "R-C",  # an in-flight / just-shipped reserved ingredient keeps R-B (the validator's rule in stagedCatalog.ts)
        "source": r["sourceOrigin"],
    })

CANDIDATES = sorted(set(i for r in rj["rows"] for i in r["newIngredients"]) - set(RESERVED_ING_IDS))
assert len(CANDIDATES) == 48, len(CANDIDATES)
assert set(used_ing) <= set(CANDIDATES), sorted(set(used_ing) - set(CANDIDATES))
ing_ids = CANDIDATES  # WS-I registers ALL 48 candidates; I-1 / I-2 only change their status (reversible)
out_ings = []
for i in ing_ids:
    k = KIND[i]
    cat = category_of(i)
    out_ings.append({
        "id": i, "nameJa": name_of(i), "category": cat, "placement": "spread" if cat == "sauce" else "scatter",
        "kind": k, "family": None if cat != "topping" else FAMILY_OVERRIDE.get(i, FAMILY_BY_KIND.get(k, "other")),
        "composite": i in COMPOSITE, "aliasCandidate": ALIAS.get(i), "mergedFrom": sorted(a for a, b in MERGE.items() if b == i),
        "usedBy": sorted(used_ing[i]),
        "status": "ACTIVE" if used_ing[i] else ("MERGED_PROVISIONAL" if i in MERGE else "ALIASED_PROVISIONAL"),
    })
for x in out_ings:
    assert x["id"] not in SHIPPED_ING and x["id"] not in RESERVED_ING_IDS, x["id"]

def ts(v): return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False)
HDR = "// GENERATED by docs/reports/data/TETO_FULL-EXPANSION-177_stage-gen.py.txt -- do not edit by hand (re-run the generator).\n// STAGED ONLY (Issue #780, Owner P-1 2026-11-07): never imported by production code (stagedIsolation.test.ts). PROVISIONAL data: minCount,\n// family, category and names are placeholders; ids are candidates (final ids are re-judged before promotion). Lives in testSupport/: the repo convention\n// for modules production never imports (only tests read it today); a promotion train moves rows into the real catalog files.\n"
with open(P("src/data/staged/testSupport/stagedRecipes.ts"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(HDR + 'import type { StagedRecipe } from "../stagedTypes";\n\nexport const STAGED_RECIPES: readonly StagedRecipe[] = [\n')
    for x in out_recipes:
        f.write("  " + ts(x) + ",\n")
    f.write("];\n")
with open(P("src/data/staged/testSupport/stagedIngredients.ts"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(HDR + 'import type { StagedIngredient } from "../stagedTypes";\n\nexport const STAGED_INGREDIENTS: readonly StagedIngredient[] = [\n')
    for x in out_ings:
        f.write("  " + ts(x) + ",\n")
    f.write("];\n")
print(json.dumps({"recipes": len(out_recipes), "ingredients": len(out_ings),
  "applied": collections.Counter(a.split(":")[0] + ":" + ("kept" if "kept" in a else "reuse" if "reuse" in a else a.split(":")[1]) for x in out_recipes for a in x["applied"]),
  "lanes": collections.Counter(x["lane"] for x in out_recipes)}, ensure_ascii=False, default=dict))
